title: Worker hello with the node fields
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 1 "Capabilities" and 5 step 1), not implemented. Today's worker hello (stt-worker-hello.schema.json) plus the node's capabilities: a worker sends them in full in its hello, and their content hash with them. Both keys are optional, so every hello a worker sends today is valid here, and a hub from before this ignores them.
